description: This Go source file implements internationalization (i18n) support for the Mattermost server, including translation loading, locale management, and translation functions.

methods.name: TranslationsPreInit
methods.description: Loads translations from a directory, initializing the translation functions.

methods.name: TranslationsPreInitFromFileBytes
methods.description: Loads translations from a byte buffer, useful for embedded translation files.

methods.name: InitTranslations
methods.description: Sets default server and client locales and initializes translation functions.

methods.name: initTranslationsWithDir
methods.description: Helper to load translation files from a directory.

methods.name: GetTranslationFuncForDir
methods.description: Returns a function to access translations for a given directory.

methods.name: GetTranslationsBySystemLocale
methods.description: Returns the translation function for the system's current locale.

methods.name: GetUserTranslations
methods.description: Returns the translation function for a specific user locale.

methods.name: GetTranslationsAndLocaleFromRequest
methods.description: Determines translation function and locale from HTTP request headers.

methods.name: GetSupportedLocales
methods.description: Returns a map of supported locale codes and their translation file paths.

methods.name: tfuncWithFallback
methods.description: Wraps a translation function with fallback to default locale.

methods.name: TranslateAsHTML
methods.description: Translates a string and returns it as HTML, with special formatting.

methods.name: escapeForHTML
methods.description: Escapes various argument types for safe HTML rendering.

methods.name: IdentityTfunc
methods.description: Returns a translation function that does not translate, only returns the ID.

methods.name: isSupportedLocale
methods.description: Checks if a locale is supported.
